input: Create a custom rubber stamp for my small business packaging

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The stamp could serve very different purposes — a logo, a return address, a 'thank you' message, fragile warnings, or social media handles — which completely changes the design brief.
Knowing whether the user will design it themselves or hire someone determines the workflow and tools needed.
The surface being stamped (kraft paper, tissue paper, cardboard boxes, fabric bags) affects the ink type and stamp size required.
Budget and timeline determine which vendors or DIY options are realistic — rush orders and premium vendors cost significantly more.
Style and visual tone (minimal, playful, elegant, hand-drawn) must align with the brand and directly shape the artwork.
The volume of use (a few orders a week vs. hundreds) determines whether a self-inking stamp, a traditional rubber stamp, or a photopolymer stamp is the right investment.
Whether the user already has artwork/a logo ready or is starting from scratch changes the immediate first step entirely.

gold.taskTitle: Design and order a custom business packaging stamp
gold.taskDescription: Create a custom rubber stamp to brand or label small business packaging, covering design, ordering, and practical use.

questions.title: What will the stamp actually say or show?
questions.description: Identify the content of the stamp — logo, business name, return address, 'handmade with love' message, social handle, etc.

questions.title: What surface will you be stamping onto?
questions.description: Determine the packaging material — kraft paper bags, cardboard boxes, tissue paper, fabric pouches — to select the right ink and stamp construction.

questions.title: Do you already have a logo or finished artwork file?
questions.description: Find out if the user has ready-to-use artwork or needs to create or commission a design first, which defines the starting point.

questions.title: Will you design this yourself or hire a designer?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs a DIY design tool recommendation, a freelancer, or just a vendor that offers in-house design services.

questions.title: What is your budget for the stamp itself?
questions.description: Establish a spend range to filter vendor options — from budget DIY kits under $20 to professional custom stamps costing $50–$150+.

questions.title: What visual style should the stamp reflect?
questions.description: Capture the desired aesthetic — minimal and modern, rustic and hand-drawn, bold and graphic, elegant and serif-based — to guide artwork decisions.

questions.title: How many packages do you stamp per week roughly?
questions.description: Gauge usage volume to recommend the right stamp mechanism — a traditional wood-handle stamp for occasional use vs. a self-inking stamp for high-volume daily use.
